newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI CUTS REF RATE TO 18.6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI CUTS REF RATE TO 18.6 PCT.

text.p: Komercni Banka a.s., the largest Czech commercial bank, said on Tuesday it was cutting its key reference rate to 18.6 percent from 19.6 percent with effect from Wednesday, June 25.
Komercni added in a statement that it would simultaneously cut its base rate to 16.5 percent from 17.3 percent.
Komercni said the changes had been made because of an easing of interest rates on the interbank market.

"Komercni Banka, on the basis of the decline in interest rates on the interbank money deposit market will cut, with effect from Wednesday June 25, 1997 its reference rate by one percent from 19.6 percent to 18.6 percent and its base rate by 0.8 percent from the original 17.3 percent to 16.5 percent."
On Tuesday six month interbank rates fell to 18.5 percent from 19.69 percent. Komercni sets its reference rate according to developments in six month money on the interbank market.
